people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
translations.bsb: that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
translations.kjv: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
translations.asv: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.
